responsibility: Provides the DFA scheduling model for IBM POWER8, including its dispatch-group structure, cracked-instruction rules, separate fixed-point, load, store, VSU, branch, and CR resources, and the timing/bypass behavior for scalar, vector, VSX, crypto, and atomic instructions. This is the microarchitecture-specific scheduling file GCC uses when targeting POWER8 and when reasoning about prefixed grouping and vector issue behavior distinct from POWER7 or POWER9.
